secoes.corpo:
Based on assessment of risks to skin integrity and mobility.

Processing clinical reasoning...

A NANDA diagnosis requires a careful evaluation of its taxonomies and the search for defining characteristics and related factors. The disclosure of diagnoses on this scale serves only an educational purpose, to promote its use and help users become familiar with the various diagnoses. Under no circumstances should it induce the user to indiscriminately apply any nursing diagnosis without the support of clinical findings obtained through history taking, physical examination, and other systematic tools that will guide the nurse in prescribing care.
